content_of_post_to_comment: If universal healthcare is such a widely popular idea, why don’t supporters of it create a nonprofit that operates under the same conditions as universal healthcare where they all donate a percentage of their income every year? Why do they believe in forcing this upon all citizens?
comment: The nonprofit comparison raises an interesting distinction: private charity asks individuals to opt in, while public healthcare debates whether health access is a collective obligation like roads or education. The real question is where that line should be drawn.
